title: secrets-init
description: Payload of `ssh-cli secrets init --json` (`event: "secrets-init"`). Never contains key material.

key_source.description: Where the primary key lives after the run: `xdg_file`, `file` or `keyring`. Never `env`: a key from the environment is rejected

key_file.description: Path of `secrets.key`, reported even when the key lives in the keyring and the file may not exist

reencrypted_hosts.description: Hosts re-encrypted under the new key, always present and 0 unless `--force` rotated an existing key over a config file

force.description: Whether `--force` was passed, which rotates an existing primary key
